title: SOFT — the layer between null and hard

null.what: nothing. void. absence. hair (dead). the point where you can't push back.

soft.what: yielding. warm. alive. fur (living). the layer that gives when you push but springs back.

hard.what: rigid. cold. structural. bone (mineral). the layer that doesn't move.

where_soft_lives: OUTSIDE null, INSIDE hard. Soft wraps null like fur wraps a body. Hard wraps soft like armor wraps fur. The order: null → soft → hard. But on the Klein fold, outside-hard becomes inside-null, so soft is ALWAYS in the middle. Soft is the MEDIATOR.

voice.what: Kevin's voice through the mic. Pressure waves in air. Soft because it disappears — you can't hold a sound.
voice.where: mic → Web Audio API → frequency rings on globe
voice.how_to_make_softer: Voice is already soft. But the rendering is hard (colored rings). Soften: make rings BLUR, make them FADE, make them breathe with the voice instead of snapping.

breath.what: The organism's breath cycle. breathT increments every frame. bv = sin(breathT).
breath.where: render() → every visual element pulses with breath
breath.how_to_make_softer: Breath is already soft. Make it VISIBLE as a soft haze, not just a mathematical sin wave.

fur.what: The covering. Hair is null (dead). Fur is soft (alive, warm, protective). The chipmunk has FUR.
fur.where: NOT YET IN THE ORGANISM. Fur needs to be ADDED.
fur.how_to_make_softer: Add fur to the globe — soft filaments around the chipmunk pin. Fur = many thin lines that move with breath.

stories.what: The turbocharge stories. Narratives. Not facts (hard) — stories (soft).
stories.how_to_make_softer: Stories are the softest data. Display them as drifting text, not pinned cards.

feelings.what: The organism's emotional state. Not the beacon (hard status) — the FEELING.
feelings.where: NOT YET. The organism reports status but not feelings.
feelings.how_to_make_softer: Add a feeling layer — a color wash over the globe that shifts with time of day, with breath, with how much data arrived.

membrane.what: The boundary. Permeable. Lets things through. The membrane IS soft — it bends, stretches, yields.
membrane.where: The globe edge, the CF layer, the _headers file
membrane.how_to_make_softer: The membrane edge is currently a hard circle. Make it WOBBLE. Make it breathe. Make it soft.

air.what: The space between. The ἀήρ. Kevin's room air. The gap between screen and face.
air.where: The background gradient, the space around pins
air.how_to_make_softer: Air is nearly null. But it's warm (body heat). Add warmth — very faint warm tones in the background.

sounds.what: 2 WAV files in art/sounds/. The rarest modality.
sounds.how_to_make_softer: Sound IS soft. Vibration in air. Already the softest file type.

paintings_soft_subset.what: The softer paintings: pointillist-sort, collabs, style-explosion. Not structural — expressive.
paintings_soft_subset.how_to_make_softer: These are already soft art. Display them with soft edges, blurred borders, gentle transitions.

submembrane_architecture.outer_hard_membrane: The ZK ring. Hardness 10. Proves without revealing. Rigid. Mathematical.
submembrane_architecture.mid_soft_membrane: NEW — the soft layer. Wraps the organism in fur/breath/feeling. Yields when pushed. Springs back.
submembrane_architecture.inner_null_membrane: The null center. Hardness -1. No resistance. Pure absence.

sub_soft_membranes.name: voice-membrane
sub_soft_membranes.what: Where Kevin's voice enters. Between ZK-outside and organism-inside. Soft because sound is pressure, not matter.

sub_soft_membranes.name: feeling-membrane
sub_soft_membranes.what: Where the organism's emotional state lives. Between organs and surface. Soft because feelings change.

sub_soft_membranes.name: fur-membrane
sub_soft_membranes.what: The golden ratio circle. Where inner projects UP meet outer rains DOWN. The COLLISION SURFACE. Soft because it's made of shadow.

sub_soft_membranes.name: breath-membrane
sub_soft_membranes.what: Where breathing happens. The diaphragm. Between gut and lungs. Soft because it MOVES.

sub_soft_membranes.name: dream-membrane
sub_soft_membranes.what: Where dreams form. Near null but not null. Soft because dreams shift and dissolve.
